relations.subject: Ajahn Sucitto
relations.evidence: He was, between 1992 and 2014, the abbot of Cittaviveka, Chithurst Buddhist Monastery.

relations.subject: Ajahn Sucitto
relations.evidence: Ajahn Sumedho had taken up residence in the Hampstead Buddhist Vihara in 1977, and readily accepted Sucitto as a disciple. Sucitto trained under Ajahn Sumedho for much of the ensuing fourteen years.

relations.subject: Ajahn Sucitto
relations.role: degree in English and American Literature
relations.evidence: Before entering monastic life, Ajahn Sucitto graduated from the University of Warwick with a degree in English and American Literature in 1971.

relations.subject: Ajahn Sucitto
relations.evidence: he was inspired by a meditation class in English in Wat Meung Maung given by an English monk, Phra Alan Nyānavajīro.

relations.subject: Ajahn Sucitto
relations.evidence: co-authored (with Nick Scott) a two-volume account of the six-month walking pilgrimage that they undertook in India and Nepal between November 1990 through April 1991
